title: Joukowsky instant valve closure
description: Frictionless pipe after an instantaneous valve closure: the classic Joukowsky pressure rise ρaV₀ travels upstream as a sharp front until it reaches the reservoir. Because the front is a discontinuity carried by a linear wave equation, a first-order fixed-grid scheme converges in L1 only at order ½ (p/(p+1) for order p), which sets the convergence target; the storage balance checks mass exactly.

citations.title: Über den hydraulischen Stoss in Wasserleitungsröhren
citations.report_number: Mem. Acad. Imp. Sci. St.-Petersbourg Ser.8 9(5)

criteria.rationale: Peak pressure within ±2% of Joukowsky rise Δp = ρ a V0.

Mass balance with no free parameter: until the first reflection the reservoir keeps delivering V0 while the valve is shut, and the pipe must store exactly that volume by compression, so ∫Δp dx = ρa²V0t. A conservative scheme meets it to round-off; 1 % allows non-conservative interpolation schemes that are otherwise accurate.
